name: Definition of Done Workshop
deliverable: Technical consensus alignment on quality gates for release readiness

steps.text: Name the increment the criteria cover, then list what must be true before it is finished.
Turn vague items into pass-or-fail checks, tested against a recent release and its defects.
Publish the checks and name who may change them.

failure: Activity criteria: the list records work done, such as code reviewed, but not what must be true for done.
intervention: Take each item and ask how a reviewer verifies it in five minutes; if no one can, rewrite it as a check.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A shared team standard from Scrum practice; no single documented originator.
